commands.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "2a05bc9bbed67adbb9d48b12c7a070d5cca4e639"; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build >/dev/null; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android >/dev/null; (cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug >/dev/null); ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; ENDPOINT="$("$ADB" mdns services | awk '/adb-RFCT70L7E8J/ && /_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $3; exit}')"; test -n "$ENDPOINT"; "$ADB" connect "$ENDPOINT" >/dev/null; APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; echo ADB_ENDPOINT=$ENDPOINT; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" install -r "$APK"; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell am force-stop link.localclimate.app; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell am start -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 2; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=|lastUpdateTime=' | head -10 | tr -d '\r'; echo PID=$("$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r'); git status --short
